name: Hockenheimring
summary: Layout, length, direction and start line are right. The circuit is almost flat (lidar range 4.2 m, max 1.8 % over 50 m) but the game's GLO-90 surface model doubles the range (7.9 m) and invents a 5 m hump on the Parabolika (forest canopy: +2.9 % / -3.7 %) and +-2.5 % around the Sachs-Kurve. The derived banking gives 4-6 deg in the hairpin and in Nord / Sued-Kurve that are 1-1.6 deg in reality. Scenery: three phantom concrete decks float over the road (OSM outlines of the track own decks over service tunnels).

findings.game: GLO-90 (surface model) heights: range 7.9 m; a hump on the Parabolika (1.3-1.6 km after the line) up to 5.3 m above the lidar with +2.9 % / -3.7 % over 100 m; -2.5 % / +2.4 % around the Sachs-Kurve; -2 % 620 m after the line; max 3.1 % / -4.1 % over 50 m. RMS error 1.72 m.
findings.real: LGL-BW DGM1 lidar: 100.3 m ASL (Sachs-Kurve) to 104.5 m (Bernie-Ecclestone-Kurve), range 4.2 m; the Parabolika is flat (101.4 m +-0.05 over 800 m); max 1.8 % / -2.4 % over 50 m.
findings.proposedFix: ELEV_SOURCE 'de-1932' = a new LGL-BW DGM1 source (4 open-data XYZ zips, 2 km tiles, see proposedCorrection.elevationSource) with the terrain-model settings; or FLAT_TRACKS-style treatment. Profile in out/profile-de-1932.json.
sources: LGL-BW DGM1 (1 m lidar DTM, 2022 survey, Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0), https://opengeodata.lgl-bw.de/data/dgm/dgm1_32_{467,469}_{5462,5464}_2_bw.zip; cached in devtests/track-audit/cache/bw-dgm1-xyz/

findings.game: Curvature-derived bank: Spitzkehre (hairpin) 5.2-6.0 deg, Nordkurve 4.2-5.0, Bernie-Ecclestone-Kurve 4.8-5.7, Suedkurve 3.8-5.1, Mobil 1 Kurve 3.5-3.8.
findings.real: Lidar cross slope: Spitzkehre 1.4-1.5 deg, Nordkurve 0.9-1.0, Bernie-Ecclestone 2.3-2.4, Suedkurve 1.5-1.6, Mobil 1 1.2-1.7; only the Sachs-Kurve (Motodrom) has a real 4.9-5.8 deg camber (game 4.3-5.2: fine). de.wikipedia: the banked "Ostkurve" (8 % Ueberhoehung) belonged to the pre-2002 long circuit, gone.
findings.proposedFix: bankOverrides from the lidar to flatten the hairpin / Nordkurve / Suedkurve (proposedCorrection.bankOverridesFromLidar), or cap the derived bank for tight corners.
sources: LGL-BW DGM1 (1 m lidar DTM, 2022 survey, Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0), https://opengeodata.lgl-bw.de/data/dgm/dgm1_32_{467,469}_{5462,5464}_2_bw.zip; cached in devtests/track-audit/cache/bw-dgm1-xyz/

findings.game: Right side (correct); entry 114 m before the line, exit 164 m after; 80 km/h. The game's pit lane (js/track.js) is generated beside the start / finish straight from up to 250 m before to 250 m after the line; it cannot follow a real lane that leaves at a chicane or rejoins after the first corner.
findings.real: OSM way 15446020 "Boxengasse" (865 m, relation role pitlane): leaves 380 m before the line (inside of the Suedkurve) and rejoins 532 m after it (after the Nordkurve). No source found for a limit other than 80 km/h.

findings.game: js/scenery.js builds THREE floating concrete decks over the road: 554 m after the line (after the Nordkurve, underside 8.0 m above the road; screenshot shots/shot-hockenheim-phantom1.png), and in the Motodrom 3240 m and 3384 m after the line (8.5 / 8.2 m; shots/shot-hockenheim-phantom2.png).
findings.real: They are OSM ways 1302356195, 1302600378 and 1302600377 (man_made=bridge, layer 1): the lap's own decks over the service / foot tunnels 31320990, 192994934, 26336602 and 534265659 (layer -2) that pass UNDER the lap. Nothing crosses over the lap in OSM. The DTM shows no dip there.
findings.proposedFix: Drop OSM ways 1302356195, 1302600377, 1302600378 from the scenery bridges (proposedCorrection.sceneryBridgesToDrop) or skip man_made=bridge outlines that carry the lap.
sources: OpenStreetMap (ODbL) via the Overpass API, cached in devtests/track-audit/cache/overpass/de-1932.json; ways 1302356195 / 1302600377 / 1302600378 and the tunnels

elevationSource.label: LGL-BW DGM1 1 m lidar DTM (2022), Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0, "LGL-BW (2026)"
elevationSource.format: ZIP with four 1 km XYZ text files each ("E N H", ETRS89 / UTM 32N, 1 m pixel centres at .50, heights in m DHHN2016); ~12 MB per zip; reader in devtests/track-audit/be-nl-de-gb/dem.mjs (bwXyz)
elevationSource.doNotUse: the INSPIRE WCS owsproxy.lgl-bw.de/.../WCS_INSP_BW_Hoehe_Coverage_DGM1 returns 16-bit integers (1 m quantisation)

sceneryBridgesToDrop.rule: a man_made=bridge outline that contains the lap centreline and has a tunnel / layer<0 way crossing the lap inside it, or a bridge=yes raceway inside it, is the lap own deck: do not build it over the road (tools/build-scenery.mjs or js/scenery.js addBridge)

bankOverridesFromLidar.note: optional, minor: replaces the curvature-derived bank where the 0.5-1 m lidar DTM measures a different cross slope (+-4 m about the OSM centreline, median of 3 samples 10 m apart); the full measured series is under measurements.crossSlope.series

measurements.method: devtests/track-audit/be-nl-de-gb/audit.mjs: game = tracks-data.js + js/track.js built in node (out/game-<id>.json from dump-game.js); OSM = Overpass (cache/overpass/<id>.json), the F1 lap chained from its raceway ways in their oneway direction; DEM sampled every 5 m along the OSM centreline, 25 m median + 5 m Gauss; game heights mapped to the OSM centreline by nearest point and aligned by the mean difference

direction.note: fraction of game samples whose direction agrees with the OSM oneway raceway direction

startFinish.note: 1 m after the game's line (game s = 0)

elevation.dem: LGL-BW DGM1 1 m lidar DTM (2022 survey), open data XYZ tiles opengeodata.lgl-bw.de/data/dgm/ (Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0)

crossSlope.note: lidar cross slope = atan((h(left) - h(right)) / (2 * halfBase)), negative = left side lower; game bank = samples[i].bank (same sign convention); median of 3 measurements
